questions.instructions: Evaluate parity classification for JS-309 (engine.io-parser node: should encode/decode a string + Buffer payload '4test\x1ebAQIDBA=='). Swift maps to SocketEnginePacketCodecTest.testEncodeDecodeAStringPlusBufferPayload.
True if JS-283 is adapted to Swift native architecture where the engine dispatches 'test' to client.messages instead of returning a Packet struct from a standalone parser.

True if Swift testFailToDecodeAMalformedPacket asserts the specific error payload string or error reason ('parser error' or 'Got unknown error from server') rather than only client.errors.count == 1 and engine.closed.
True if Swift decodes all 5 packet types (open, close, ping, pong, message) in a single parsePollingMessage payload call matching JS decodePayload('0\x1e1\x1e2probe\x1e3probe\x1e4test').
True if Swift testDecodeEveryPacketTypeOfAPayload asserts client.pings or client.pongs counts after parsing the payload containing '2probe' and '3probe'.
True if Swift parsePollingMessage stops iterating remaining packets when a CLOSE packet ('1') is encountered, because handleClose marks the engine closed and the loop guards !closed.
True if packet type '0' (open) is included in the payload string passed to parsePollingMessage in testDecodeEveryPacketTypeOfAPayload.

True if testEngineClosesOnEveryMalformedEnginePayload tests the malformed payloads '{', '{}', '[\"a123\", \"a456\"]' using the polling payload decoder parsePollingMessage rather than parseEngineMessage.
True if Swift parsePollingMessage('') reports an error or closes the engine matching JS decodePayload('') which returns [{ type: 'error', data: 'parser error' }].
True if Swift testEncodeDecodeABuffer asserts both that raw binary Data is sent unencoded when polling=false and that parseEngineData delivers the identical Data to client.binary.
True if Swift testEncodeDecodeABufferAsBase64 asserts that polling binary creates 'bAQIDBA==' and parseEngineMessage('bAQIDBA==') delivers the decoded Data to client.binary.

True if JS-308 ArrayBuffer vs Buffer distinction is a reviewed platform boundary where Swift unifies binary representations into Foundation.Data while asserting byte preservation and non-text dispatch.
True if Swift testEncodeDecodeAStringPlusBufferPayload verifies both encoding of '4test\u{1e}bAQIDBA==' and payload decoding delivering both client.messages ['test'] and client.binary [payload].

Rate the remediation priority for JS-285 gaps (omitted open packet '0' in payload decode, unasserted ping/pong counts, and inability of fused parsePollingMessage to decode beyond CLOSE '1' in a single payload).

Rate the remediation priority for JS-286 gaps (malformed payload tests bypassing parsePollingMessage in favor of parseEngineMessage, and parsePollingMessage('') silently returning without closing or reporting error).
Rate the remediation priority for JS-284 gap (error message text reason is not asserted, only error count and closed state).
True if testDecodeEveryPacketTypeOfAPayload can immediately assert client.pings == 1 and client.pongs == 1 because EngineCodecClient already tracks engineDidReceivePing and engineDidReceivePong.
True if testEngineClosesOnEveryMalformedEnginePayload can be updated to exercise parsePollingMessage instead of parseEngineMessage to test payload decoding.
True if changing guard !str.isEmpty in parsePollingMessage to handle empty string as malformed payload would be needed to match JS decodePayload('') error packet behavior.
